**计算：**
- 同比增长 = ($39,306M − $29,878M) / $29,878M × 100
- = $9,428M / $29,878M × 100
- ≈ **31.56%**
- 四舍五入后，管理层报告为 **32%（报告汇率）** 和 **31%（固定汇率）**。

### 问题3：哪些是已经发生的事实，哪些是管理层对未来的前瞻性表述？

逐条标注如下：

| # | 归因因素 | 性质 | 判定依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" | **已发生事实** | 使用现在进行时 "continues to exceed"，描述 Q4 期间持续存在的状态。 |
| 2 | "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" | **已发生事实** | 用过去式 "was ahead of"，陈述已发生的结果及其已确认的原因。 |
| 3 | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" | **已发生事实** | 描述 Q4 期间已完成的流程改进及其已实现的效果（"was quickly monetized"）。 |
| 4 | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" | **已发生事实** | "following the June business model change" 指已发生的具体事件，"benefited" 是对已实现结果的分析。 |
| 5 | "renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts" | **已发生事实** | "were ahead of expectations primarily driven by" — 用过去式陈述已确认的原因。 |
| 6 | "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply" | **前瞻性表述** | "remain focused on delivering" 和 "we see" 是当前持续的态度/立场，"bridge the gaps" 指向未来要采取的行动。 |
| 7 | "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | **前瞻性表述** | "continue to expect" 明确是未来预期；"H1 growth to accelerate" 是对未来时期的预测。 |
| 8 | "year-over-year Azure growth rates can vary quarter-to-quarter based on capacity timing and contract mix" | **前瞻性表述** | 这是对 FY27 Q1 及未来 Azure 增长波动性的提醒，属于对未来的指引。 |
| 9 | "we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion, or growth of 33% to 34%" | **前瞻性表述** | "we expect" 是典型的未来指引用语，针对的是 FY27 Q1。 |

**区分依据总结：**
- **已发生事实**：使用过去时态（was, grew, benefited）、现在进行时（continues to）描述 Q4 期间已存在或已确认的状态，以及具体已发生事件（如 June business model change）。
- **前瞻性表述**：使用 "expect"、"remain focused on"、"continue to expect"、"can vary" 等措辞，指向 FY27 Q1 及以后的未来期间，包含指引、预期和态度声明。
